answer: Two years cannot be bought: every identity must own a domain at least two years old, in the public WHOIS record, hosting a live page answering a fresh nonce. One domain, one identity, a crowded wharf, one berth per ship; claimed, parked, or young domains are refused. A fresh domain costs $24 plus 730 days per fake, so 100 fakes cost $2,400 and 73,000 days, a pigment of patience no script can print. The cheapest cheat is aged domains at $200 each, so 100 fakes cost $20,000 with no wait, but supply is thin, bulk buying spikes prices, and a nebula of rented names falls when one lapses.
